versions.content: {DRAFT} If EthIfGlobalTimeSupport is set to TRUE for a Synchronized Time Base, then the StbM shall derive the current value of the Fallback Virtual Local Time from the freerunning HW counter from the corresponding Eth- ernet Controller via EthIf_GetCurrentTimeTuple . If EthIf_GetCurrentTimeTuple returns either ETH_UNCERTAIN or ETH_INVALID for member timeQuality of parameter currentTimeTuplePtr , then the StbM shall ignore the time value timestampClockValue returned by EthIf_GetCur- rentTimeTuple .
